findings.title: evaluate() docstring still says it returns a list after the signature changed to a dict
findings.body: In src/sentry/workflow_engine/processors/detector.py, the docstring of StatefulDetectorHandler.evaluate (around line 229-233) reads "Evaluates a given data packet and returns a list of `DetectorEvaluationResult`." This PR changed the return type of evaluate to dict[DetectorGroupKey, DetectorEvaluationResult] (both on the abstract DetectorHandler and the stateful implementation), but the docstring was not updated. Anyone implementing the abstract hook based on the docstring would build and return a list, which would break process_detectors (it iterates detector_results.values() and keys results by group_key) and fail type checks. Update the docstring to describe the dict keyed by group key.
